notes: Twenty-one entrants across two championship tournaments — fourteen wrestlers in seven singles pairings, seven teams across three tag pairings and one first-round bye (Annihilation) — the full bracket, every entrant billed. The federation's own operator wrote on 5 January 1993 that a complete rundown would go out from the 11th; no result of any of it survives on the discs, which stop three weeks later.
